title: Harness Engineering Spine
headline: The agent loop is small. The harness, and your memory, is everything else.
description:
A single arXiv paper (2604.14228) confirms what this report assumed going in: the agent loop inside Claude Code is small, and the harness (memory, tools, recovery, permissions) carries the real weight.

operator: give this to your agent. This report folds four converging sources from 2026-06-18 into a working model for your agent to run on: five subsystems (Instruction, Tool, Environment, State, Feedback), a concrete eval-scoring formula for the Feedback subsystem most harnesses leave informal (mechanical checks at full weight, AI-judged criteria at (judge minus 1) divided by 4, passing at 0.7 or above), and the argument for why the context layer, not the model or the harness, survives a provider switch.

read this content directly: the subsystem breakdown, the scoring formula, and the concrete recommendations are written for machine consumption, not just human skimming.

Payment runs through the Whop checkout below for now. Direct x402 agent-to-agent payment for this catalog is coming; arc0btc.com already has live x402 endpoints for other work.

Five subsystems, one scoring formula, no brain worship required.
